facts.text: The museum describes all its theaters as accessible and lists wheelchair locations and companion seats in the Special Effects Theater and Planetarium. Ask a theater attendant about reserving those spaces.
facts.quote: All theaters are accessible—the Special Effects Theater and the Planetarium include wheelchair locations and companion seats. See a theater attendant for more information about reserving these spaces.

facts.text: The museum describes restrooms throughout its facility and grounds as accessible and locates wheelchair-accessible drinking fountains near the main interior restrooms; it does not give fixture dimensions. Its accessibility page also says visitors may reenter the exhibits at any time.
quote: All restrooms throughout the facility and grounds are accessible. Wheelchair accessible water fountains are also available near the main interior restrooms.
Reentrance to the exhibits can be done at any time during your visit.
